A fence with no language is left alone and reported:

```
untyped content
stays exactly as written
```

Indented code has no language either:

    indented code
    second line

A quoted untyped fence:

> ~~~
> quoted untyped
> ~~~

An indented block with an interior blank line and trailing blank lines:

    first indented line

    last indented line


But the rest of the document (like  this   badly spaced paragraph) is still formatted.
